description: ISOPHOT PHT-P multi-band photometer: relative system responses of the 14 filters of detectors P1 (Si:Ga, 3.3-16 micron), P2 (Si:B, 20 and 25 micron) and P3 (Ge:Ga, 60 and 100 micron), from the ISO Handbook Vol. IV.
facility_description: The Infrared Space Observatory (ISO) was an ESA infrared space telescope; ISOPHOT, the Imaging Photo-Polarimeter, was one of its four instruments (ISO Handbook Vol. IV: 'PHT - The Imaging Photo-Polarimeter', Laureijs, Klaas, Richards, Schulz & Abraham, ESA SP-1262, Version 2.0.1, June 2003; ISOPHOT Instrument Consortium, PI D. Lemke, MPI Astronomie, Heidelberg).

notes: Curves read from the vector figures (Figures A.1-A.6, PDF pages 248-251) of the ISO Handbook Vol. IV Appendix A.2: each curve is the plotted polyline (no smoothing or resampling), mapped to wavelength and response with the axis tick labels (fit residual <= 0.01 % of the axis span). The handbook's numeric Cal-G tables PPFILTRAN/PCFILTRAN (Sect. 14.24) are not publicly downloadable. Response scale is the handbook's 'System Response' (filter and field lens transmission x relative detector response). Pivot wavelengths agree with SVO's ISO/PHT-* copies within 0.04 %. DetectorType energy from the handbook's in-band power definition (Appendix C.2.1, Eq. C.2).
